dog.description_text:
Knick Knack is a charming tuxedo kitty with a big love for people and all the pets they have to offer!

Knick Knack is a sweet girl who enjoys entertaining herself with little bouncy balls, playing with her own tail and soaking up attention from her favorite humans. She also appreciates the quieter side of life, especially peaceful moments sitting beside her people and simply enjoying their company. Whether she's showing off her playful side or keeping you company during a relaxing afternoon, Knick Knack is ready to bring a little fun, sweetness and lots of love into her future home!

Ready to make Knick Knack a part of your family? Click the "Adopt Me" button and come meet your new best friend!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: KNICK KNACK
